rows.notes: Current estimate in EPRI's 2026 report: 'In several states, the share already exceeds 10%, with the highest concentration in Virginia, where the DC share exceeds 25%.'

rows.source_title: EPRI, Back Pocket Insights: Powering Intelligence, Updated U.S. Data Center Scenarios
rows.notes: 'Virginia is the only state today where data centers consume over 20% of electricity, increasing to 39-57% by 2030. In the Medium scenario, eight states exceed 20% shares by 2030.'

rows.source_title: Smith, Hubbard, Newkirk et al., United States Data Center Energy Usage Report: 2025 Update, LBNL
rows.notes: 4.7% of US electricity consumption; 521 to 843 TWh projected for 2030.

rows.notes: 'Northern Virginia is the largest data center market in the world, constituting 13 percent of all reported data center operational capacity globally and 25 percent of capacity in the Americas.'

rows.notes: 'A typical residential customer of Dominion Energy could experience generation- and transmission-related costs increasing by an estimated $14 to $37 monthly in constant (or real) dollars by 2040.' Data centers 'are currently paying their full cost of service'.

rows.notes: 'In 2023, the data center industry used an estimated 2.1 billion gallons of water, with just over a third coming from reclaimed water sources.' 11 buildings each used over 50 million gallons; one used 243 million (chapter 5).
